info.name: Bé An Toàn Số API Collection
info.description: Bộ sưu tập đầy đủ 52 APIs của hệ thống Bé An Toàn Số phục vụ cho phát triển ứng dụng di động Flutter và Web.

item.name: list ALL self-registered student accounts (admin only) Self-registered members live in `profiles` (linked to Supabase Auth users). Teacher accounts are excluded so only learners/students are returned.

request.description: GET /api/admin/students — list ALL self-registered student accounts (admin only) Self-registered members live in `profiles` (linked to Supabase Auth users). Teacher accounts are excluded so only learners/students are returned.

item.name: reset a self-registered student's password (admin only) Self-registered students authenticate via Supabase Auth, so we update the auth user directly.

request.description: POST /api/admin/students/[id]/reset-password — reset a self-registered student's password (admin only) Self-registered students authenticate via Supabase Auth, so we update the auth user directly.

item.name: list ALL students created/imported by teachers (admin only) These accounts live in `teacher_students` and authenticate with a teacher-assigned code + password. Admin sees every teacher's students across the whole system.

request.description: GET /api/admin/teacher-students — list ALL students created/imported by teachers (admin only) These accounts live in `teacher_students` and authenticate with a teacher-assigned code + password. Admin sees every teacher's students across the whole system.

item.name: reset a teacher-created student's password (admin only) These students authenticate with a bcrypt-hashed password stored in teacher_students.

request.description: POST /api/admin/teacher-students/[id]/reset-password — reset a teacher-created student's password (admin only) These students authenticate with a bcrypt-hashed password stored in teacher_students.
